svg.aria-label: Two red snakes eat contributions; two blue snakes restore them along independent randomized routes
svg.title: Contribution snakes — two eat, two restore
svg.desc: Independent experiment based on https://github.com/Platane/snk. Two red snakes eat in parallel; two blue snakes restore original colors behind their tails. Shared grid, independent randomized body-safe paths, original movement speed, no gauge.
